All your catalogs, on every device
Save several catalogs in %1$s → %2$s and switch between them while browsing. Signed in to Quire, the list follows you to your other devices.

Books with a file name for a title, or no cover, author or description, now get their details from Open Library or tidied by AI, with a label saying which. Turn it off in %1$s → %2$s, or go back to a book’s original details from its menu.
